HomePage.title: Your All-in-One <primary>PDF Toolkit</primary>
HomePage.subtitle: Securely process your PDF files directly in your browser. Your documents never leave your device.

features.privateDesc: Files are processed locally on your device. No uploads to servers.
features.noLimitsDesc: Process as many files as you need without size restrictions.
features.freeDesc: No accounts, no subscriptions, no hidden fees.

why.title: Why Use PDFinery?
why.description: All processing happens in your browser. Your files never leave your device—no uploads to our servers, no installation, and no account required. PDFinery is a free, secure PDF merger and reorder tool that works on any device with a modern web browser.

organize.title: Organize
organize.description: Merge multiple PDF files into one document. Reorder pages with drag and drop, and remove unwanted pages.

split.title: Split
split.description: Split PDF into multiple files by range, extract specific pages, or split into single pages.

convert.title: Convert
convert.description: Convert PDFs to high-quality images (PNG/JPG) or extract text securely. No file uploads required.

sign.title: Sign & Secure
sign.description: Sign documents with your personal signature. Draw, type, or upload your signature image.

optimize.title: Optimize
optimize.description: Compress and optimize your PDF files. Reduce file size and remove metadata.
